Priya: @here neon bowling + bento swap this Friday? thinking Alleyway Lanes, 6:30pm. pay-at-door ~$25 and bring one bento to share if you can. :bowling: :bento:
Jon: in! can bring extra chopsticks. heads up i'm allergic to shellfish so no sushi for me pls
Emma: :raised_hands: i can do a veg bento (tofu katsu). 6:30 works for me
Diego: out this week, client call. remote this time but would love the next one! :sweat_smile:
Sam: i can reserve lanes. want 2 lanes for 12 ppl? @Priya i can book if you confirm number
Priya: yes please Sam, 2 lanes sounds great. i'll cover soda, anyone want to bring beer/snacks? rsvp by Thu EOD. put your thumbs up here or add to the doodle: https://doodle.com/poll/abcd1234
lunch-bot: Poll created: "Neon Bowling + Bento Swap" — options: Yes, Yes (veg bento), Remote, Can't make it (added by Priya)
Jon: thumbs up. i'll mark "Yes" on doodle and note shellfish allergy
Emma: added vegetarian option on doodle. also happy to bring extra napkins/soy sauce
Priya: awesome, thanks! i'll post calendar invite once Sam confirms the booking and we have final headcount. :sparkles:
